message: Assign each non-self edge a score inversely proportional to its distance, so shorter edges receive stronger heuristic preference; set diagonal entries to zero. import numpy as np def heuristics_v2(distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray: distances = np.asarray(distance_matrix, dtype=float) if distances.ndim != 2 or distances.shape[0] != distances.shape[1]: raise ValueError("distance_matrix must be a square NumPy array") scores = np.zeros_like(distances, dtype=float) mask = ~np.eye(distances.shape[0], dtype=bool) positive_distances = np.maximum(distances[mask], np.finfo(float).eps) scores[mask] = 1.0 / positive_distances return scores
